notes_en:
Lookup/Core learning tracks, AI timeout fix, and calmer result UI
1. **New**: Clear Lookup vs Pure Core learning split; Core phrase modules; dual-star history tracks.
2. **Fixed**: AI timeouts no longer stick on loading; Instant cancels in-flight AI; Instant-only history no longer forces AI mode.
3. **Improved**: Unified result section headings; removed decorative dots/emoji/redundant AI pills.
4. **Engineering**: vitest unit tests; Settings module lists and docs synced.
